heroHeadline: Prestige Parklane — Luxury High-Rise Living in Aerospace Park
heroSubtitle: Master-planned luxury residential enclave with open green panoramas, signature clubhouse, and direct aerospace tech corridor connectivity.
editorialStory:
Experience refined architectural luxury in North Bengaluru, engineered for biophilic tranquility and strategic connectivity across Devanahalli and Kempegowda International Airport.

Set across 11.76 acres with 75% dedicated to landscaped gardens, tree-lined avenues, and active sports courts, Prestige Parklane provides the ultimate balance of urban vibrancy and quiet sanctuary.

Backed by Prestige Group’s legacy of landmark deliveries and comprehensive Karnataka RERA approvals, each residence is designed with maximum natural light, cross ventilation, and contemporary architectural finishes.

faqs.question: What is the RERA registration number for Prestige Parklane?
faqs.answer: Prestige Parklane is registered with Karnataka RERA under registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/150926/008941.

faqs.question: Where is Prestige Parklane located?
faqs.answer: The project is situated in KIADB Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, North Bengaluru, right next to the hardware and aerospace SEZs and just 15 minutes from Kempegowda International Airport.

designBrief:
Create a premium, visually immersive and high-converting real-estate landing page for a luxury residential project in Gurugram/Gurgaon using the project information available in the dashboard.

The design must be completely ORIGINAL.

Do not copy the exact layouts, text, logos, imagery, or visual identity of any existing real-estate developer.

The website should feel like a premium international property brand operating in Gurugram.

==================================================

1. CORE VISUAL CONCEPT
   ==================================================

Design personality:

* Modern metropolitan luxury
* Sophisticated
* Contemporary
* Architectural
* Confident
* Minimal
* Editorial
* Premium urban lifestyle
* High-end Gurgaon positioning

Think:

LUXURY HOTEL
+
ARCHITECTURE MAGAZINE
+
PREMIUM RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY WEBSITE

The design should feel polished and expensive without becoming overly decorative.

Use:

* Strong visual hierarchy
* Large typography
* Large architectural photography
* Editorial compositions
* Generous whitespace
* Thin borders
* Controlled motion
* Premium micro-interactions

Avoid:

* Generic property templates
* Excessive rounded cards
* Bright gradients
* Neon effects
* Excessive glassmorphism
* Emoji
* Excessive icons
* Cluttered layouts
* Cheap-looking sales banners

==================================================
2. COLOUR PALETTE
=================

Use ONLY this colour system.

PRIMARY:

Midnight Navy:
#0B1F33

Deep Navy:
#071522

SECONDARY:

Pearl:
#F4F1EA

Soft Pearl:
#E8E4DA

Neutral Grey:
#8A8D91

Dark Slate:
#343B42

ACCENT:

Burnt Clay:
#B85C45

PREMIUM ACCENT:

Muted Copper:
#A77B5A

WHITE:

#FFFFFF

COLOUR RULES:

* Midnight Navy is the main brand colour.
* Deep Navy is used for hero overlays, dark sections and footer.
* Pearl should be the primary light-background colour.
* Soft Pearl can separate sections.
* Burnt Clay should be used sparingly for primary CTAs and selected highlights.
* Muted Copper should only appear as a premium decorative accent.
* Grey should be used for supporting text and dividers.
* White should be used for maximum contrast.

DO NOT introduce additional colours.

Do not use:

* bright blue
* purple
* pink
* lime
* bright green
* yellow gradients

==================================================
3. TYPOGRAPHY
=============

Use a sophisticated editorial typography combination.

PRIMARY DISPLAY FONT:

Playfair Display

Use for:

* Hero headline
* Large section headings
* Editorial statements
* Large quote sections

SECONDARY FONT:

DM Sans

Use for:

* Navigation
* Body text
* Buttons
* Forms
* Labels
* Property specifications
* Supporting information

Typography style:

Hero:
Very large Playfair Display headline

Navigation:
Small DM Sans

Eyebrow:
DM Sans uppercase
Letter spacing approximately 0.12em

Body:
DM Sans
Comfortable line-height

Numbers:
Playfair Display

Buttons:
DM Sans Medium/Semibold

Maintain strong contrast between elegant serif headlines and clean sans-serif supporting content.

==================================================
4. HEADER
=========

Create a premium sticky header.

Initial state:

Transparent over the hero image.

Left:
Project logo

Center:
Overview
The Residences
Amenities
Gallery
Location

Right:
ENQUIRE

After scrolling:

Header becomes:
Pearl background
Midnight Navy text
Subtle bottom border

Add a smooth transition.

Mobile:

Logo
Menu
Enquire button

==================================================
5. HERO
=======

Create a dramatic full-screen hero section.

Height:
85–100vh

Use the strongest available architectural property image.

Image treatment:

* cinematic
* premium
* subtle dark navy overlay
* strong contrast

Hero content:

Small eyebrow:

LUXURY RESIDENCES • GURUGRAM

Project Name

Large headline:

A NEW
PERSPECTIVE
ON LIVING.

Supporting information:

[SECTOR / LOCATION]
[CONFIGURATION]
[PROJECT SIZE]

Primary CTA:

BOOK A PRIVATE VISIT

Secondary CTA:

EXPLORE RESIDENCES

Add a subtle bottom scroll indicator.

Hero should immediately communicate luxury and location.

==================================================
6. PROPERTY STATISTICS
======================

Create a clean premium statistics band below the hero.

Use 4–5 verified metrics.

Examples:

[XX] ACRES
[XX] RESIDENCES
[3 / 4 BHK]
[XX]% OPEN SPACE
[STATUS]

Numbers:
Playfair Display

Labels:
DM Sans uppercase

Use thin lines rather than heavy cards.

==================================================
7. INTRODUCTION
===============

Create an editorial split-screen section.

Left:
Large vertical architectural image

Right:

PROJECT OVERVIEW

A large headline:

BUILT FOR
A HIGHER
WAY OF LIVING.

Add 2–3 concise paragraphs describing:

* project concept
* architecture
* lifestyle
* privacy
* location
* landscape
* design philosophy

Use a text link:

EXPLORE THE PROJECT →

==================================================
8. ARCHITECTURE
===============

Create a cinematic architecture section.

Title:

ARCHITECTURE
WITH INTENT.

Show large imagery of:

* building facade
* entrance
* lobby
* balconies
* architectural details
* landscaped surroundings

Use alternating image/text compositions.

Do not use repetitive cards.

Use thin copper lines as decorative elements.

==================================================
9. SIGNATURE FEATURES
=====================

Create a section called:

THE SIGNATURE EXPERIENCE

Show 5 premium experiences.

Example:

01
THE ARRIVAL

02
THE CLUB

03
THE WELLNESS COLLECTION

04
THE LANDSCAPED GROUNDS

05
THE PRIVATE RESIDENCE

Each feature should include:

* large image
* title
* 1–2 lines of description

Use hover effects with subtle image zoom.

==================================================
10. AMENITIES
=============

Create a sophisticated amenities section.

Use a visual editorial grid.

Categories:

WELLNESS
Gymnasium
Yoga
Spa
Meditation

LEISURE
Clubhouse
Pool
Lounge
Entertainment

SPORTS
Tennis
Badminton
Jogging
Fitness

FAMILY
Children's Areas
Lawn
Community Spaces

Only include amenities from the supplied project information.

==================================================
11. RESIDENTIAL EXPERIENCE
==========================

Create a premium section focusing on the homes.

Heading:

EVERY DETAIL,
CONSIDERED.

Use large interior imagery.

Show:

Living
Dining
Kitchen
Bedroom
Bathroom
Balcony

Add concise descriptions about:

* natural light
* materials
* views
* proportions
* privacy
* finishes

Do not invent specifications.

==================================================
12. FLOOR PLANS
===============

Create an elegant residence-planning section.

Heading:

FIND YOUR SPACE.

Use tabs:

3 BHK
3.5 BHK
4 BHK
PENTHOUSE

Only display available configurations.

Each tab:

Floor plan image
Unit size
Configuration
Key features

CTA:

VIEW FLOOR PLAN

Use a clean navy/pearl interface.

==================================================
13. GALLERY
===========

Create a cinematic gallery.

Do not use a simple repetitive square grid.

Use:

* one panoramic image
* two portrait images
* one large horizontal image
* supporting details

Gallery filters:

ARCHITECTURE
INTERIORS
LANDSCAPE
AMENITIES
LIFESTYLE

Add full-screen lightbox functionality.

==================================================
14. LOCATION
============

Create a strong location section.

Heading:

AT THE CENTRE
OF WHAT MATTERS.

Show:

* project location
* major roads
* metro
* airport
* commercial districts
* schools
* hospitals
* retail

Only display verified data.

Use an elegant dark map treatment where possible.

Connectivity can be displayed as:

DESTINATION
TIME / DISTANCE

Do not invent travel times.

==================================================
15. GURUGRAM LIFESTYLE SECTION
==============================

Create a lifestyle-focused section specifically communicating the project's relationship with Gurugram.

Use relevant imagery and supplied information to highlight:

* business districts
* retail
* dining
* entertainment
* connectivity
* urban convenience

Headline:

CONNECTED TO
THE CITY'S RHYTHM.

Keep this section concise and visual.

==================================================
16. LARGE EDITORIAL STATEMENT
=============================

Create a dramatic full-width visual section.

Use a beautiful dusk/evening architectural image.

Overlay:

LIVE DIFFERENTLY.
LIVE COMPLETELY.

Use Playfair Display.

Small supporting copy beneath.

Create substantial whitespace around the statement.

==================================================
17. DEVELOPER
=============

Create:

THE DEVELOPER

Include:

* developer logo
* company introduction
* years of experience
* projects delivered
* verified statistics
* certifications / awards when available

Use a restrained layout.

Do not fabricate statistics.

==================================================
18. CREDIBILITY
===============

Create a compact credibility band.

Potential verified elements:

RERA REGISTERED
YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
PROJECTS DELIVERED
CONSTRUCTION PARTNERS

Display only data available in the dashboard.

==================================================
19. TESTIMONIALS
================

Add testimonials only when actual testimonials are available.

Use:

Large Playfair Display quotation
Customer name
Optional image
Optional designation

Keep the section minimal.

==================================================
20. LEAD CAPTURE
================

Create a dramatic conversion section.

Background:
Deep Navy #071522

Text:
Pearl #F4F1EA

Heading:

YOUR NEW ADDRESS
IS CLOSER THAN YOU THINK.

Supporting copy:

Request project details or schedule a private visit.

Form:

FULL NAME
PHONE NUMBER
EMAIL
PREFERRED CONFIGURATION

Primary CTA:

BOOK A PRIVATE VISIT

Secondary CTA:

REQUEST BROCHURE

Primary CTA accent:

Burnt Clay #B85C45

Use subtle copper details.

==================================================
21. MOBILE CONVERSION BAR
=========================

On mobile create a fixed bottom bar:

CALL
WHATSAPP
BOOK VISIT

Make it highly usable but visually premium.

==================================================
22. FAQ
=======

Create an elegant accordion FAQ.

Possible topics:

Project Location
Configurations
Sizes
Amenities
Possession
RERA
Pricing
Site Visit
Brochure

Only answer questions using dashboard data.

Never invent information.

==================================================
23. FOOTER
==========

Create a minimal luxury footer.

Background:
Deep Navy #071522

Text:
Pearl #F4F1EA

Include:

Project Logo
Developer Logo
Contact Details
Navigation
Privacy Policy
Terms
RERA Information
Statutory Disclaimer

Use Muted Copper #A77B5A for tiny visual details.

==================================================
24. BUTTON STYLE
================

Buttons should be rectangular or slightly softened.

Avoid oversized pill-shaped buttons.

Primary:

Burnt Clay background
Pearl text

Secondary:

Transparent
Pearl/Navy border depending on background

Hover:

Subtle colour transition
Small elevation
No excessive animation

==================================================
25. ANIMATION
=============

Use premium, slow, restrained movement.

Include:

* fade-in
* image reveal
* subtle zoom
* text reveal
* smooth scroll
* sticky header transformation
* button hover transitions
* light parallax only where appropriate

Do not over-animate.

The website should feel calm and premium.

==================================================
26. IMAGE DIRECTION
===================

Prioritize:

* luxury towers
* modern architecture
* dramatic facades
* premium interiors
* landscaped areas
* clubhouses
* pools
* lifestyle imagery
* skyline views
* evening architecture
* aerial property photography

Image colour grading should work naturally with:
Midnight Navy
Pearl
Burnt Clay

Use supplied project images whenever available.

==================================================
27. COPYWRITING
===============

Tone:

* Premium
* Intelligent
* Confident
* Contemporary
* Elegant
* Concise

Use architectural/editorial headlines.

Examples:

A DIFFERENT
WAY TO ARRIVE.

DESIGNED FOR
WHAT COMES NEXT.

THE CITY.
THE SPACE.
YOUR LIFE.

WHERE MODERN LIVING
TAKES SHAPE.

A HOME WITH
A DISTINCT POINT OF VIEW.

Avoid exaggerated claims such as:

"Best project in Gurgaon"
"Guaranteed returns"
"No. 1 investment"
"Unmatched opportunity"

unless directly supported by verified project data.

==================================================
28. DATA ACCURACY
=================

CRITICAL:

Only use information supplied in the dashboard/project data.

Never invent:

* pricing
* unit sizes
* number of units
* towers
* possession dates
* RERA numbers
* amenities
* awards
* developer statistics
* connectivity times
* investment returns

When information is missing:

Hide the field OR use:

[PRICE ON REQUEST]

Do not fabricate information.

==================================================
29. FINAL VISUAL IDENTITY
=========================

The finished page should have this exact visual personality:

MIDNIGHT NAVY
+
PEARL
+
SOFT STONE
+
BURNT CLAY
+
MUTED COPPER

Typography:

PLAYFAIR DISPLAY
+
DM SANS

The website should feel:

Urban
Architectural
Sophisticated
Contemporary
Premium
Gurugram-focused

It must visually differ from a traditional black-and-gold luxury property website and from a natural green luxury property website.

Build the COMPLETE landing page.

Include:

* responsive desktop
* tablet
* mobile
* sticky navigation
* hero
* property statistics
* project overview
* architecture
* signature features
* amenities
* residences
* floor plans
* interiors
* gallery
* location
* developer
* testimonials when available
* enquiry form
* FAQ
* footer
* mobile CTA
* interactions and animations

Do not create only a hero section.
